সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 1) ''Timon of Athens'' written by William Shakespeare is a/an -
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Timon of Athens, tragedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, probably written sometime in 1605–08 and published in the First Folio of 1623 from an authorial manuscript, probably unfinished.
Some parts of the play may be by Thomas Middleton. It belongs to Shakespeare’s late experimental period, when he explored a new kind of tragic form.
Shakespeares' other Tragedies are:
Hamlet, Macbeth, Othello, King Lear, Julius Caesar, Romeo and Juliet, Antony and Cleopatra, Titus Andronicus, etc.
Source: Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 2) Who wrote the book 'The Mistaken Husband'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
John Dryden is the Father of Modern English Criticism.
His famous works are All for Love, The Indian Emperor, Aureng-Zebe, The Mistaken Husband, Absalom and Achitophel, MacFlecknoe, The essay of Dramatic Poesy, The Conquest of Granada, The Medal of John Bays.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 3) Who is the writer of 'The Revenger's Tragedy'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Cyril Tourneur, (born c. 1575—died Feb. 28, 1626, Kinsale, County Cork, Ire.), English dramatist whose reputation rests largely upon The Atheist’s Tragedie, which is written in verse that is rich in macabre imagery.
His some other literary works are:
The Revenger's Tragedy, The Transformed Metamorphosis etc.
Source: Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 4) The author of the 'Essays' -
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Francis Bacon is called a natural philosopher. He is also called the Father of English Essay and Father of Modern Prose.
His famous works are Essays, Advancement of Learning, Novum Organum, The Wisdom of Ancients, Divine and Humane and The New Atlantis, etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 5) Who is the writer of 'Canterbury Tales'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Geoffrey Chaucer is the father of modern English Poetry.
His best writings are Canterbury Tales, Troilus and Criseyde.
He is also called Father of English Language, Father of English literature, First Humourist in English Literature, The First great Modernist.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 6) Who is considered to be the greatest satirist of the 18th century?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Jonathan Swift is the greatest satirist of the 18th century.
His famous works are Gulliver's Travels, A tale of a Tub, The Battle of the Books, A Modest Proposal, A Journey to Stella.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 7) The author of 'Holy Living and Holy Dying' is-
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
The author of 'Holy Living and Holy Dying' is Jeremy Taylor. It is a sermon in prose.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 8) Which period was replete with lyrics and songs?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
The Elizabethan age is a period of original romanticism. This period was replete with lyrics and songs.
This period is called the Golden age of English literature/Golden Period of English Drama/A nest of singing birds.
Duration of Elizabethan Period is 1558 to 1603.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 9) 'Ralph Roister Doister' is a ___ by Nicholas Udall.
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Ralph Roister Doister, the first English comedy, is written by Nicholas Udall. Gorboduc, the first English tragedy, is written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville. Pamela, the first novel of English Literature, is written by Samuel Richardson.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 10) What is the theme of 'Paradise Lost'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.option1: ক) To Justify the way of man to God
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.option2: খ) Show the Satan and God have equal power
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.option3: গ) To Justify the way of God to man
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.option4: ঘ) Explain why good and evil are necessary
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
The theme of 'Paradise Lost' is 'To Justify the way of God to man'.
He is called an Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 11) 'The Rape of Lucrece' is written by-
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
William Shakespeare has three narrative poem. Such as The Rape of Lucrece, Venus and Adonis, A Lovers Complaint.
On the other hand, The Rape of the Lock was written by Alexander Pope.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 12) Who wrote the poem 'To His Coy Mistress'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Andrew Marvell is an English Metaphysical poet and politician.
His notable works are To His Coy Mistress, The Definition of Love, The Garden etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 13) Who is the Father of English Tragedy?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Christopher Marlowe is the Father of English Drama/Tragedy. He is a University wit.
He is the founder of Blank Verse in English Literature.
His notable plays are Doctor Faustus, The Jew of Malta, Tambeurlaine the Great, Edward II, Didu, Queen of Carthage, The Massacre of Paris etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 14) Who wrote the book 'Leviathan'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Thomas Hobbes is a political philosopher in Commonwealth Period of English literature. His famous book is Leviathan.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 15) Who supervised the compilation of 'The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:

He is known as 'The Law Governing'.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 16) 'As You Like It' by William Shakespeare is a-
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist. He is mostly known for his plays.
His notable comedies are As You Like It, The Tempest, The Comedy of Errors, Twelfth Night, The Taming of The Shrew, Mid Summer Night's Dream, The Two Gentleman of Verona, The Merry Wives of Windsor, The Winter's Tale, Cymbeline, Pericles, Prince of Tyre, The Two Nobel Kinsman, Much Ado About Nothing, Love's Labours Lost.
source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britanncia.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 17) Who wrote the novel 'Ressalas'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Dr. Samuel Jonson is the Father of English dictionary. He is the first lexicographer in English.
His famous books are A Preface to Shakespeare, Rasselas: Prince of Abissinia, The False Alarm, The Adventure, Life of the English Poets etc.
His famous poem is 'The Vanity of Human Wishes'.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 18) Who wrote the book 'Captain Singleton'?

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 19) Who is the author of 'An Apology for Poetry'?

His famous books are Arcadia (A book that bears the embryo of English Novel), The Lady of May, An Apology for Poetry.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 20) Who wrote the epic 'Beowulf'?

Beowulf is the Earliest Epic in English literature (England).

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 21) Who is the writer of the book 'Hudibras'?

Samuel Butler is the writer of Restoration Period. His famous satire in verse is Hudibras.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 22) Who translated 'The Bible' into English from Latin?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
John Wycliffe is called the father of English prose. He translated The Bible into English from Latin.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 23) Who is famous for 'Comedy of Manners'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
William Congreve was famous for Comedy of Manners.
His famous plays are The Way of The World, Love for Love, The Double Dealer, The Old Bachelor etc.
On the other hand, Ben Jonson is famous for comedy of humors.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica and Live MCQ lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 24) Who wrote the book 'Utopia'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Thomas Moore is a social philosopher, English lawyer, author and statesman.
He wrotes the book 'Utopia'. The book 'Utopia' (or Kingdom of Nowhere) was originally written in Latin in 1516.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 25) Who is the writer of 'The Rape of the Lock'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Alexander Pope is called Mock Heroic Poet.
His famous epic is The Rape of the Lock.
His notable works are An Essay on Criticism, The Dunciad, The Imitation of Horace, An Essay on Man, Letter to Gay.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 26) Who is the author of the book 'The Unfortunate Traveller'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Thomas Nashe is a University Wit. He wrotes the book 'The Unfortunate Traveller'.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 27) Who wrote the elegy 'Lycidas'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
John Milton is called Epic Poet. He is also called 'A great master of verse in Puritan Period'.
'Lycidas' is his famous Elegy.
His famous epics are Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 28) Who is the writer of 'The Vicar of the Wakefield'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Oliver Goldsmith is an Irish novelist, playwright and poet.
His famous works are The Citizen of the World, The Vicar of the Wakefield, The Traveller, The Deserted Village, The good Natured Man, She Stoops to Conquer.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 29) Who is not a 'University Wits'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Elizabethan Period এর একদল Young dramatist and pamphleteers (ক্ষুদ্র পুস্তিকা রচয়িতা) দেরকে University Wits বলা হয়।
তাঁরা Oxford and Cambridge University এর Scholar/Witty students ছিলেন। তাঁরা অনেক বিখ্যাত নাটক রচনা ও মঞ্চস্থ করার মাধ্যমে খ্যাতি অর্জন করেছিলেন।
University Wits ছিলেন মোট ৭ জন। এঁরা হলেন- Christopher Marlowe, Thomas Kyd, Robert Greene, George Peele, Thomas Nashe, John Lyly and Thomas Lodge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 30) Who wrote the poem 'The Canonization'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
John Donne is a Metaphysical Poet. He is also called Poet of Love and Religious Poet.
His famous poems are The Good Morrow, The Flea, The Ecstasy, The Sun Rising, The Canonization, Twicknam Garden, For Whom The Bell Tolls etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 31) 'The Merchant of Venice' is a comedy of William Shakespeare about-
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
The Merchant of Venice, comedy in five acts by William Shakespeare, written about 1596–97 and printed in a quarto edition in 1600 from an authorial manuscript or copy of one.
Bassanio, a noble but penniless Venetian, asks his wealthy merchant friend Antonio for a loan so that Bassanio can undertake a journey to woo the heiress, Portia.
Antonio, whose money is invested in foreign ventures, borrows the sum from Shylock, a Jewish moneylender, on the condition that, if the loan cannot be repaid in time, Antonio will forfeit a pound of flesh.
Source: Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 32) The first novel of English literature is-
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Pamela or Virtue Rewarded, the first English novel, is written by Samuel Richardson.
Beowulf is the Earliest Epic in English literature
Euphues, a book that bears the embryo of English novel, is written by Thomas Lyly.
Gorboduc, the first English tragedy, is written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 33) Who is the greatest English dramatist?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
William Shakespeare is the greatest English dramatist.
He was born on 23 April, 1564 AD and died on 23 April, 1616 AD.
His Birth place is Stratford Avon. He is often called the bard of Avon.
Shakespearean period belongs to '1590-1616'.
He wrotes 37 plays and 154 sonnets.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 34) Who is the writer of 'Rape Upon Rape'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Henry Fielding regarded as 'Father of English Novel'.
His famous novels are Tom Jones, Amelia, Joseph Andrews, Jonathan Wilde, Top Secret.
His famous plays are Rape Upon Rape, The Temple Beau, The Tragedy of Tragedies, The Modern Husband.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 35) Who wrote the book 'The Ruins of Time'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Edmund Spenser is called the poet of poets.
His notable works are The Faerie Queen (Epic), the Shepherds Calendar, The Ruins of Time.
His famous sonnet collection is Amoretti.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 36) Who wrote the book 'Every Man in His Humour'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Ben Jonson is called a neo-classicist because he followed the classical rules of drama: Every Man in His Humour, Every Man Out of His Humour.
His comedies are known as 'Comedy of Humors'.

His other famous works are - The Magnetic Lady, Volpone, The Silent Woman, The Alchemist, The Devil is an Ass, etc.

Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Britannica.com

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 37) Who is the author of 'The Recruiting Officer'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
The author of The Recruiting Officer and The Beaux's Stratagem is George Farquhar.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 38) Which is the first romance in prose?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Morte d' Arthur, the first romance in prose, is written by Thomas Malory.
Piers Plowman is written by William Langland.
Cinfessio Amantis is written by John Gower.
Gorboduc, the first English tragedy, is written by Thomas Norton and Thomas Sackville.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 39) Who is the author of 'The Spanish Tragedy'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
Thomas Kyd is the Father of English Revenge Tragedy.
His famous play is 'The Spanish Tragedy'. It is called Bloody Drama.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 40) Who is the writer of 'The Duchess of Malfi'?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
John Webster is the poet of Jacobean period.
His famous tragedies are The Duchess of Malfi, The White Devil, The Devil's Law Case etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature, Dr. M Mofizar Rahman and Live MCQ Lecture.

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 41) যদি x, y বাস্তব সংখ্যা এবং x ≠ 0, y ≠ 0 হয়, তবে x<sup>0</sup> + y<sup>x<sup>0</sup></sup> কত?

x0 + yx0

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 43) 625(√5)<sup>2x</sup> = 1 হলে x এর মান কত?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
625(√5)2x = 1
বা, (√5)2x = 1/625
বা, (√5)2x = 1/(5×5×5×5)
বা, (√5)2x = 1/(√5)8
বা, (√5)2x = (√5)-8
বা, 2x = -8
বা, x = -4

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 44) ১ থেকে ৫০ পর্যন্ত বিজোড় সংখ্যাগুলোর গড় কত?
45) a<sup>b</sup> = b<sup>a</sup>, a = 2b, a ≠ 0, b ≠ 0 হলে (a, b) = কত?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
দেওয়া আছে, ab = ba, a = 2b
এখন, ab = ba
বা, (2b)b = b2b
বা, 2b . bb = (bb)2
বা, 2b = bb
বা, 2 = b
সুতরাং, b = 2
এখন, a = 2b = 2×2 = 4

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 46) ২ - ৪ + ৮ - ১৬ ...... ধারাটির প্রথম সাতটি পদের সমষ্টি কত?
47) (1000)<sup>x/3</sup> = 10 হলে x এর মান কত?
48) একটি সমান্তর ধারার সাধারণ অন্তর ৯ এবং ৭তম পদ ৬০ হলে ১২তম পদটি কত?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
আমরা জানি, সমান্তর ধারার প্রথম পদ, a এবং সাধারণ অন্তর, d হলে n তম পদ = a + (n-1)d
এখানে, ৭তম পদ, ৬০ = a + (৭-১)৯
বা, ৬০ = a + ৫৪
বা, a = ৬
সুতরাং ১২তম পদ = ৬ + (১২-১) ৯
= ৬ + ১১ × ৯
= ৬ + ৯৯
= ১০৫

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 49) 3.2<sup>n</sup> - 4.2<sup>(n-2)</sup> = কত?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
3.2n - 4.2(n-2)
= 3.2n - 22.2(n-2)
= 3.2n - 2(2+n-2)
= 3.2n - 2n
= 2n (3-1)
= 2n × 2
= 2(n+1)

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 50) ২ + ৪ + ৮ + ১৬ + ....... ধারাটির n সংখ্যক পদের সমষ্টি ২৫৪ হলে n এর মান কত?
সমন্বিত রিভিশন.exp:
এখানে প্রদত্ত ধারাটি একটি গুণোত্তর ধারা। যার, সাধারন অনুপাত, r = ৪/২ = ২
প্রথম পদ, a = ২
আমরা জানি, n-তম পদের সমষ্টি = a . (rn - 1)/(r-1)
শর্তমতে, a . (rn - 1)/(r-1) = ২৫৪
বা, ২. (২n - ১)/(২-১) = ২৫৪
বা, (২n - ১) = ২৫৪/২
বা, (২n - ১) = ১২৭
বা, ২n = ১২৭ + ১
বা, ২n = ১২৮
বা, ২n = ২৭
বা, n = ৭

সমন্বিত রিভিশন.question: 53) log<sub>2</sub><sup>√6</sup> + log<sub>2</sub><sup>√(2/3)</sup> = কত?
